_comment: Meter presets. verified: "docs" means the url and field names were read from the service's official documentation (date in each note). live: true means a real call succeeded with a user key on the date given in the note; it does not mean every field of every response was checked. live: false means no live response has confirmed them. To check yourself: set KEY locally, run curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" <url>, and compare the JSON with value_path / total_path / currency_path. verified: false means unchecked (new-api / one-api are note-only, no url). Dotted paths: a number segment indexes a list. Keys starting with _ are ignored.

deepseek.note: Field names read from https://api-docs.deepseek.com/api/get-user-balance on 2026-10-14. total_balance is a numeric string; currency is CNY or USD. Live-verified 2026-10-14 with a user key.

openrouter.note: Field names read from https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/reference/limits on 2026-10-14. usage is all-time credits used; limit is null when unlimited, which prints as 'used <n> USD (no cap)'. Live-verified 2026-10-14 with a user key.

kimi.note: Live-verified 2026-10-14 on the China site (api.moonshot.cn); currency is CNY there. The international site uses a different host and is not covered.

new-api.note: NOTE ONLY, no collector in v1. Needs two calls on the relay's own host: GET <base>/v1/dashboard/billing/subscription (hard_limit_usd) and GET <base>/v1/dashboard/billing/usage (total_usage, often in cents). One meter makes one call, so this shows as unknown (preset has no collector).

one-api.note: NOTE ONLY, no collector in v1. Same two-call shape as new-api (billing/subscription plus billing/usage).
